sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
SpeedPro is the nation's leader in large format graphics with over 20 years of industry experience, operating a nationwide network of more than 120 studios.

Industry: Printing · HQ: Centennial, CO · Size: <$50M · Products: Custom Signs & Graphics, Window Graphics, Wall Murals, Trade Show Displays, Vehicle Wraps, Event Graphics

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: SpeedPro scores 79 of 100 (tier A) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (30/30), application fit (25/25) and event engagement (15/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (22% similar on graphics, vehicle, vinyl, window); Drytac (16% similar on graphics, wall, display, vinyl); Mactac (15% similar on graphics, vinyl, vehicle, signage). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
